top_signals.title: Japan may have spent $32bn in Friday's yen intervention
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Whole Foods is Dhedding the "Whole Paycheck" Label
top_signals.summary: Under Amazon, Whole Foods is shedding its "whole paycheck" reputation. The chain has cut prices and expanded private label selection in a bid to attract inflation-bit shoppers, Matt Day explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Top Philippine Power Retailer to Refund $156 Million to Clients
top_signals.summary: Manila Electric Co., the Philippines’ largest power distributor, was ordered by the regulator to refund 9.5 billion pesos ($156 million), representing excess charges to customers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: ChatGPT dominates early AI spending in Congress as lawmakers weigh regulation
top_signals.summary: At least 70 House offices used identifiable AI tools in early 2026, with Democrats leading visible spending and broader use likely undercounted.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Derivatives Trading Sinks at Biggest Indian Bourse on RBI Curbs
top_signals.summary: India’s largest stock exchange was severely hit by the central bank’s tighter funding rules implemented last month, with spending on derivatives slumping to a 17-month low.

top_signals.title: Ripple invests in Zilo and Licuido to assist tokenized capital markets push
top_signals.summary: Ripple made a strategic investment in Zilo and Licuido as it looks to enable the use of tokenized funds as collateral from the point of issuance.
